audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers agree with each other but disagree with the packet level chart at rows 3, 4-5 and 6. The page gives Gangplank Level 3 and Levels 4-5 and gives Wukong Level 6; the packet says Skill for all three. The mirror audit (gangplank__wukong) records that BOTH layers were set to the packet chart on that side, so this side is now the one out of step.
audit.why: Win rate is 50.62% over 648 games — a genuinely even lane whose swing is late, not at 3 or 6. The page's own spikes[1] already says 'at 6 the lane is even-ish', contradicting win[4]='Wukong'.
audit.corrected: Chart set to the packet and the mirror: Wukong, Skill, Skill, Skill, Skill, Gangplank, Gangplank. Rows proposed as matched full/content pairs with ratings rescaled.

audit.why: Gangplank's spikes are Powder Keg charges coming online, level 6 Cannon Barrage (160/140/120s), and the Sheen-line first item that turns Parrrley into burst. Wukong's are level 1-3 and Black Cleaver; his ceiling is lower, hence Gangplank owning first item and 2+.
audit.corrected: spikes[] already carry these correctly; only the level-6 row's owner needed fixing.

audit.whatIsWrong: The whole page treats Powder Keg as a tracked cooldown — 'Engage only on Powder Kegs's cooldown', 'Track it before every engage', 'When it is down'. Powder Keg has no per-cast cooldown (cd 0 in the kit); it is a stored-charge placement. There is no 'down' window to engage on.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Gangplank uncovers a powder keg at target location.' The kit lists cd 0, range 1000, cost 0 — charges, not a cooldown. The punishable cooldowns in this lane are Remove Scurvy (22/20/18/16/14s), which cleanses your CC, and Cannon Barrage.
audit.corrected: Kegs store as charges, not a cooldown — destroy each on sight rather than waiting for a window. Remove Scurvy is the cleanse to play around at 22s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Same as point 4 — the 'most punishable cooldown' named across the page is a charge system.
audit.why: Remove Scurvy at 22s rank 1 is the real punish window: after he eats it your CC lands and he has no cure for the next 22 seconds.

audit.whatIsWrong: Remove Scurvy's cleanse is mentioned but never given a number, so the reader has no way to time the commit.
audit.why: 22/20/18/16/14s is a long window at rank 1 — it is the single largest tempo swing available to Wukong in this lane.

edits.before: Gangplank pulls ahead at 6 with Cannon Barrage zoning and cooldown scaling.
edits.after: Level 6 is even: Cannon Barrage zones, but Cyclone answers a barrel chain.

edits.before: Track Gangplank's Powder Kegs: Pop barrels to deny poke + gold. When it is down — E-Q + R him.
edits.after: Kegs store as charges, not a cooldown — kill each on sight. Remove Scurvy cleanses CC, 22s at rank 1.

notes: Two problems here. The page's own spikes[1] ('at 6 the lane is even-ish') supported the Level 6 flip. (2) Powder Keg is treated page-wide as a tracked cooldown, but it has no cooldown (cd 0, cost 0 in the kit) — it is stored charges.
